_README: THE OFFICIAL SAFE OPERATING LIMITS WERE NOT PUBLISHED WITH THE PROBLEM
STATEMENT. The brief names WHP, FLP and BHP as active constraints but gives
no numeric ranges. The values below are engineering placeholders, derived as
described in _derivation, and every one of them lives in this file alone.
TO ADOPT THE OFFICIAL NUMBERS: edit the six values below and re-run
Nothing in the controller, the identification or the studies hard-codes a
limit, so no other file needs to change.

rule: Bracket the operating region exercised by the reference dataset, leaving
roughly one further step of choke travel of headroom on each side, so that
the envelope is two-sided and the dataset itself is comfortably feasible.
Each limit is then attached to a physical failure mode (below), so the
numbers can be replaced by real asset values without changing their meaning.
consequences_worth_knowing: BHP_min binds first as the choke opens - production is limited by drawdown,
not by the valve. Max safe rate 166.2 bbl/hr at 70.65 % choke.
At that point WHP sits only 5.4 psi from its own limit, which is why a
single corrupted pressure transmitter causes little harm (see stress tests).

WHP_min.rationale: below this the well is prone to slugging and struggles to enter the flowline

FLP_min.rationale: minimum pressure to transport produced fluid to the separator

FLP_max.rationale: gathering-system rating downstream of the choke

BHP_min.rationale: maximum allowable drawdown - sand production and bubble-point risk

BHP_max.rationale: minimum drawdown needed for stable inflow from the reservoir

actuator._note: These four ARE specified in the problem statement.
